review:
The second Cash King, after Donny Dough. A 5x5 paylines game where Danny symbols expand into wild Dollar-Reels, nudges shift symbols into place, and a global multiplier climbs through the bonus.

It's rated medium-high – a bit softer than a lot of Hacksaw – with a 12,500x max. Game-show presentation with stage curtains, matching Donny Dough. Try it if you like the LootLines games but want more wild action.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
